# Leadio

> An AI-powered challenge and quiz system that helps coaches, consultants, creators, and experts diagnose why their lead flow is inconsistent — and guides them toward the right next step based on their answers.

## Pages

- [/](/): Find out why your leads are inconsistent with a free 9-question diagnostic quiz.
- [/free-assessment](/free-assessment): Same landing page with entry intent set to free training.
- [/challenge](/challenge): Entry point for the high-intent 3-day builder challenge.
- [/free-training](/free-training): Free training (Blueprint LMS) — 3 short lessons with an AI-powered personalised insight at the end.
- [/premium](/premium): Premium course information and sales page.
- [/assess](/assess): The canonical assessment engine — 9 questions, instant diagnosis.
- [/assessment](/assessment): Legacy alias for the assessment engine.
- [/premium-assessment](/premium-assessment): Premium course assessment entry.
- [/partners](/partners): Partner and promoter program information.
- [/waitlist](/waitlist): Join the waitlist for upcoming features.
- [/links](/links): Useful links and resources.
- [/join](/join): Sign up for the challenge.
- [/blueprint-join](/blueprint-join): Sign up for the free training.
- [/premium-join](/premium-join): Sign up for the premium course.
- [/results](/results): Quiz result page with diagnosis and recommended strategy.
- [/app/features](/app/features): Feature overview of the platform.
- [/reset-password](/reset-password): Password reset page.
